cards.card_text: Daniel is STILL praying, still confessing his own sin and the sin of his people Israel, still bringing his petition about God's holy mountain.
cards.verse_text: While I was speaking, praying, confessing my sin and that of my people Israel, and presenting my petition before the LORD my God concerning His holy mountain—
cards.snippet: While I was speaking, praying, confessing my sin and that of my people Israel, and presenting my petition…

cards.card_text: As John baptizes them in the Jordan River, the people are confessing their sins.
cards.verse_text: Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.
cards.snippet: Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.
